description: Implementation of QpackProgressiveDecoder class for decoding QPACK header blocks in QUIC protocol, including methods for decoding instructions, handling errors, and managing header table references.

classes.name: QpackProgressiveDecoder
classes.description: Handles decoding of QPACK header blocks, manages instruction decoding, header table references, and error handling.

methods.name: Decode
methods.description: Decodes incoming data stream, processes prefix and instructions.

methods.name: EndHeaderBlock
methods.description: Marks end of header block and triggers finalization.

methods.name: OnInstructionDecoded
methods.description: Handles decoded instructions and dispatches to specific handlers.

methods.name: OnInsertCountReachedThreshold
methods.description: Handles threshold event for insert count, unblocks stream.

methods.name: DoIndexedHeaderFieldPostBaseInstruction
methods.description: Processes post-base indexed header field instruction.

methods.name: DoLiteralHeaderFieldNameReferenceInstruction
methods.description: Processes literal header field with name reference instruction.

methods.name: DoLiteralHeaderFieldPostBaseInstruction
methods.description: Processes post-base literal header field instruction.

methods.name: DoPrefixInstruction
methods.description: Processes prefix instruction, decodes required insert count and base.

methods.name: FinishDecoding
methods.description: Finalizes decoding, checks for completeness, and notifies visitor.

methods.name: DeltaBaseToBase
methods.description: Calculates base value from delta and sign.
